name: IsChain.backwards_induction
statement: α → Prop) (l : List α) (h : IsChain r l) (carries : ∀ ⦃x y : α⦄, r x y → p y → p x) (final : (lne : l ≠ []) → p (getLast l lne)) : ∀ i ∈ l, p i

name: List.chains
statement: = { l : List α // l.IsChain (flip r) }  /-- The lexicographic order on the `r`-decreasing chains -/ abbrev List.lex_chains (l m : List.chains r) : Prop
